interactive_activities.title: Explore भारतीय लोक/शास्त्रीय परंपराएँ

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where सांस्कृतिक विविधता is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.instructions: Teach सम्मान to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
